'''Eta Squadron''' was a squadron of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] in service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was regularly seen in battle by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot. They were first encountered when Keyan Farlander was confirming a delivery of poisoned grain for the Empire.
